title: Discount Calculator: Sale Price, Percent Off and Original Price
description: Free discount calculator: find the sale price from a percent off, work out the percent off from two prices, or find the original price. Handles an extra coupon discount.
lead: What will I pay with 25% off? How big is this discount really? What did it cost before the sale? Pick a question, enter your numbers and get the answer to the cent, with the formula behind it.

sources.title: eCFR: 16 CFR Part 233, Guides Against Deceptive Pricing (Federal Trade Commission)
